destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: The City of Lights, synonymous with culture, architecture, food and fashion. Home to the iconic Eiffel Tower, Arc de Triomphe, and lamp-lit bridges spanning the Seine.

destinations.name: Rome
destinations.description: The Eternal City, home to the Colosseum, Vatican City, and countless ancient ruins. A testament to the grandeur of the Roman Empire.

destinations.name: London

destinations.name: Tokyo

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.description: A futuristic city in the desert, known for luxury shopping, ultramodern architecture, and a lively nightlife scene.

destinations.name: Maldives
